set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
ExtentExpr refuses any Sub, because isProvablyNonNegative cannot prove it statically. So a panel cannot be sized as the full extent minus a fixed margin (npc(1) - pt(12)), which is common in dashboards and fixed-chrome layouts. Verified at 2fa5c68.

Scope
Allow difference extents. Check non-negativity when the extent is resolved against the concrete viewport, and return a typed GraphicsError naming the expression and the resolved value when it is negative.

Acceptance criteria
1. npc(1) - pt(m) resolves correctly across resizes.
2. A negative resolution fails with a typed error, never a clamp.
3. Existing static proofs still hold for expressions without subtraction.
set.title: [Intaglio] ExtentExpr: allow difference extents such as npc(1) - pt(margin)
